title.zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，主打网络安全与长程智能体
title.en: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, its new frontier model for cyber and long tasks

summary.zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 10月28日发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，称其在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数 v5.0 上以 59 分排名第一，漏洞发现、利用验证与补丁三项安全基准领先；首批仅向部分网络防御者开放。
summary.en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon on Oct. 28, saying it ranks No. 1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (59) and leads cyber benchmarks for finding, exploiting and patching bugs. Access starts with a subset of cyber defenders.

body.zh:
Carbon 在 Gemini 4 Argon（两周前发布）基础上进一步提升编程、智能体与长程任务能力。谷歌公布的成绩包括：SEC-bench Pro 88.2%（发现漏洞）、ExploitGym 54.8%（验证可利用性）、CWE-bench 71.0%（修复）。

- 谷歌称内部测试中 Carbon 可连续运行数天处理复杂工程任务，生成安全代码的成功率比 Argon 高一倍以上。
- 安全方面，Terminal-Bench 4.0 上的成功作弊降至 0%，间接提示注入攻击成功率为 0%。
- 采取分阶段发布：本周先向部分网络防御者开放，再经 Fairwind 计划扩展到可信合作伙伴，之后面向开发者和消费者；并参与美国政府自愿性的发布前模型测试。
- 推广期价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 10 美元，之后为 4 美元/20 美元。

来源：[Google 官方博客](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-carbon/)
body.en:
Carbon builds on Gemini 4 Argon, released two weeks earlier, with gains in coding, agentic and long-horizon work. Google reports 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro (finding vulnerabilities), 54.8% on ExploitGym (exploitation) and 71.0% on CWE-bench (patching).

- Google says internal teams have seen Carbon run for days on multi-step engineering tasks, with more than 2x the secure-code success rate of Argon.
- On safety, successful cheating on Terminal-Bench 4.0 fell to 0.0% and indirect prompt-injection attack success to 0.0%.
- Rollout is staged: a subset of cyber defenders this week, then trusted partners via the Fairwind Program, then developers and consumers. Google says it is taking part in the U.S. government's voluntary pre-release testing.
- Introductory pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, rising to $4 and $20 later.

Source: [Google blog](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-carbon/)

title.zh: Axiom 用 AI 智能体在 Lean 中完整形式化“有限单群分类定理”
title.en: Axiom's AI agents fully formalize the Classification of Finite Simple Groups in Lean

summary.zh: Axiom 发布首个完整的计算机验证版有限单群分类定理（CFSG）证明：原证明约 1.5 万页、500 多篇论文；团队指挥数十个 AI 智能体在 24 天内写出约 4310 万行 Lean 代码，并发现 34 处需修正的偏差。
summary.en: Axiom released the first complete computer-checked proof of the Classification of Finite Simple Groups, a ~15,000-page result. Dozens of AI agents produced about 43.1 million lines of Lean in 24 days and surfaced 34 notable deviations from the published record.

body.zh:
有限单群分类定理被称为“巨型定理”，给出所有有限单群的完整清单：素数阶循环群、交错群、16 个李型群族，以及 26 个散在单群。

- 项目沿用“第一代证明”，基于 Mathlib 与 TauCeti，代码已在 GitHub 公开，不含 sorry。
- 形式化过程中发现大量小错误，以及 34 处值得注意的偏差，最大的一处涉及“非平衡群定理”的已发表论证；团队给出替代论证，并整理成新论文。
- 这是 AI 智能体在大规模数学形式化上的又一里程碑。

来源：[Axiom 研究博客](https://axiommath.ai/research/the-enormous-theorem-formalized/)、[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/AxiomMath/CFSG)
body.en:
The classification, nicknamed the enormous theorem, lists every finite simple group: cyclic groups of prime order, alternating groups, sixteen families of Lie type, and 26 sporadic groups.

- The project follows the first-generation proof, builds on Mathlib and TauCeti, and is public on GitHub with no sorry.
- Formalization exposed many minor errors and 34 noteworthy deviations, the biggest in a published route to the Unbalanced Group Theorem; Axiom supplied an alternative argument in a new paper.

Sources: [Axiom research blog](https://axiommath.ai/research/the-enormous-theorem-formalized/), [GitHub repository](https://github.com/AxiomMath/CFSG)

title.zh: 伊朗称油轮在霍尔木兹海峡以东触雷起火，美军否认
title.en: Iran says tanker hit mine east of Hormuz; CENTCOM rejects mine claims

summary.zh: 伊朗海军称一艘关闭追踪系统的油轮擅闯霍尔木兹海峡以东“禁区”触雷起火，并称海峡对未经协调的船只“不安全且关闭”；美军中央司令部10月28日回应称主要航道已被清雷、通行安全。
summary.en: Iran's navy said a tanker that had switched off its tracking systems struck mines east of the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire, calling the strait closed to uncoordinated ships. U.S. Central Command said on Oct. 28 the main transit routes are clear.

body.en:
Iran's navy, in a statement carried by IRNA, did not name the tanker or report casualties. It said ships seeking safe passage must coordinate with Iran's armed forces.

- CENTCOM said on X that all internationally recognized primary routes "have been cleared of sea mines by U.S. forces and remain so," and that thousands of ships use them safely.
- Independent confirmation of the strike was not available. U.S.-Iran talks begun after a June memorandum broke down over navigation in the strait.

Sources: [Anadolu Agency](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-says-oil-tanker-catches-fire-after-hitting-naval-mine-east-of-strait-of-hormuz/4102560), [Iran International](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202610286050)

title.zh: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例突破一万例
title.en: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases

summary.zh: 刚果（金）卫生部门称，截至10月25日，自5月暴发以来埃博拉（本迪布焦病毒）确诊病例达 10060 例、死亡 4887 例，病死率 48.6%；疫情已波及肯尼亚、尼日利亚等国，世卫组织呼吁持续防控。
summary.en: DR Congo reported 10,060 confirmed Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct. 25 since the outbreak began in May, a 48.6% fatality rate. Cases have spread to Kenya and Nigeria, and WHO urged sustained containment.

title.zh: 美联储按兵不动维持 3.75%–4%，两名委员主张加息
title.en: Fed holds rates at 3.75%–4%; two officials dissent in favor of a hike

summary.zh: 美联储10月28日以 10 比 2 维持联邦基金利率 3.75%–4% 不变，称通胀“仍然偏高”、需等待更多信息；理事库克和克利夫兰联储主席哈马克主张加息 25 个基点。美股三大指数小幅收涨。
summary.en: The Fed voted 10–2 on Oct. 28 to hold the federal funds rate at 3.75%–4%, saying inflation "remains elevated" and it awaits more information. Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented for a quarter-point hike. U.S. stocks closed slightly higher.

body.en:
The statement upgraded the economy to growing "at a strong pace," with robust capital investment. The Fed raised rates by a quarter point in September for the first time in three years.

- Chair Kevin Warsh said Q3 growth likely ran above 3%, led by consumer spending and double-digit business investment.
- He announced that in 2027 one of the eight FOMC meetings will focus only on strategy, with no rate vote or statement.
- The next policy meeting is in December. At the close, the Dow rose 0.19% to 52,475.10, the S&P 500 0.28% to 7,743.98 and the Nasdaq 0.27% to 26,549.85.

Sources: [Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261028a.htm), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/fed-interest-rate-decision-october-2026.html), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-7864eac2e13db75f07758ed9c39ad96b)

title.zh: 谷歌云收入翻倍但 Alphabet 盈利不及预期；微软 Azure 增 48%
title.en: Alphabet misses as Cloud doubles; Microsoft beats with Azure up 48%

summary.zh: Alphabet 三季度营收 1276 亿美元（+25%），谷歌云增 103% 至 307 亿美元，但营收与每股收益均不及预期，资本支出 514 亿美元致自由现金流为负，盘后跌逾 7%；微软营收 923 亿美元（+19%）超预期，盘后上涨。
summary.en: Alphabet's Q3 revenue rose 25% to $127.6B and Google Cloud 103% to $30.7B, but revenue and EPS missed, and $51.4B of capex pushed free cash flow negative; shares fell over 7% after hours. Microsoft beat with $92.3B (+19%) and rose.

body.en:
**Alphabet**: GAAP EPS was $2.12 versus $2.87 a year ago, partly due to an $8.7B loss on equity securities. Search grew 12% to $63.4B. CEO Sundar Pichai cited a half-trillion-dollar revenue run rate and a Gemini app at one billion users. Free cash flow was about -$9.1B; 2026 capex guidance of $195B–$205B holds, with 2027 to "increase significantly."

**Microsoft**: fiscal Q1 GAAP EPS was $4.92, Microsoft Cloud revenue $63.9B (+30%), and commercial remaining performance obligation rose 73% to $677B. Free cash flow stayed positive at about $18.6B.

Sources: [Alphabet release (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000080/googexhibit991q32026.htm), [Microsoft](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/10/28/microsoft-announces-first-quarter-results-2/), [The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/28/microsoft-and-alphabet-just-reported-earnings-putting-the-ai-boom-to-the-test/)

title.zh: 澳大利亚向中方返还两件北宋皇陵流失石刻头像
title.en: Australia returns two looted Northern Song tomb statue heads to China

summary.zh: 10月28日，澳大利亚国家美术馆在堪培拉向中方返还两件北宋皇陵石刻头像，分别出自河南巩义永裕陵武官像和永昌陵文官像，约1994年被盗流失海外。
summary.en: On Oct. 28 the National Gallery of Australia returned to China two Northern Song limestone statue heads, a military official from Yongyu Mausoleum and a civil official from Yongchang Mausoleum in Gongyi, Henan, stolen around 1994.

body.zh:
武官头像高 68 厘米、重 132 公斤，文官头像高 70 厘米、重 223 公斤，是北宋皇陵石刻艺术的代表性文物。中方于 2025 年提交证据，双方依据国际公约与双边协议完成返还。

来源：[新华网](https://www.xinhuanet.com/20261028/ddb6bbf315254452902146f2d8ddc311/c.html)、[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-10-28/Australia-returns-two-Northern-Song-Dynasty-sculpture-heads-to-China-1RBJzHlmtJC/p.html)

title.zh: 外交部：欢迎瑞士联邦主席访华，回应默茨“减少依赖”言论
title.en: China MFA welcomes Swiss president's visit, responds to Merz on dependence

summary.zh: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆10月28日宣布瑞士联邦主席帕姆兰将访华、习近平将会见，称自贸合作是中瑞关系最大亮点；对德国总理默茨呼吁减少对华“单方面依赖”，回应称中德中欧合作底色是互利共赢。
summary.en: MFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun said Oct. 28 that Swiss President Parmelin will visit and meet Xi Jinping, calling free trade the highlight of ties. On Merz's call to cut "one-sided dependence," he said China-EU cooperation is mutually beneficial.

sources.name: 中华人民共和国外交部

body.zh:
今年是中瑞建立创新战略伙伴关系 10 周年。郭嘉昆指出，瑞士是最早同中国签订自贸协定的欧洲大陆国家，今年 8 月又率先同中方完成自贸协定升级谈判。

- 针对默茨在新加坡呼吁欧亚中等强国建立战略联盟、减少“不健康的单方面依赖”，郭嘉昆称希望德方、欧方保持客观理性，通过对话磋商化解分歧，共同维护产业链供应链稳定。
- 被问及姆巴佩就涉毛泽东言论道歉，他表示“我们重视当事人作出的道歉”。
- 对胡塞武装袭击沙特机场、炼油厂等目标，中方反对攻击民用目标，呼吁对话谈判。

来源：[外交部例行记者会](https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/web/fyrbt_673021/jzhsl_673025/202610/t20261028_12048462.shtml)

title.zh: 姆巴佩涉毛泽东言论风波：中国赞助商解约，央视停播西甲
title.en: Mbappé's Mao remark costs him Chinese sponsors; CCTV suspends La Liga

summary.zh: 姆巴佩在法国节目中称一张把他的脸P到毛泽东像上的梗图是“某位中国独裁者”，东鹏饮料、蒙牛、妙可蓝多相继解约，中央广播电视总台暂停转播西甲及其相关比赛；姆巴佩已用中法英三语道歉。
summary.en: After Mbappé called a meme of his face on Mao's image "some Chinese dictator," Dongpeng, Mengniu and Milkground ended deals and China Media Group suspended La Liga coverage. He apologized in Chinese, French and English.

body.en:
China Media Group also pulled ads featuring him and said it would "watch his actions even more closely." La Liga said the remarks were personal and announced a communication protocol for players. China's foreign ministry said on Oct. 28 it "values" the apology. Whether broadcasts have resumed could not be confirmed as of Oct. 28.

Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/china-mbappe-football-sponsor-meme-controversy.html), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/sport/20261027-kylian-mbappe-china-mao-zedong-sponsorship-deal)

title.zh: GitHub 正式推出 Copilot Fusion，智能编排多模型；代理已发起逾四成 PR
title.en: GitHub launches Copilot Fusion; agents now start over 40% of pull requests

summary.zh: GitHub 在 Universe 宣布 Copilot Fusion 正式可用：按任务自动路由与编排模型，提供 Standard/High/Max 三档；Octoverse 称截至9月逾40%的 PR 由智能体起草首稿，3月时仅17%。
summary.en: At Universe, GitHub made Copilot Fusion generally available—auto routing and orchestrating models at Standard, High or Max effort. Octoverse says agents drafted the first version of over 40% of PRs by September, up from 17% in March.

body.zh:
Copilot Fusion 把 Project HydraFusion 的多模型编排与自动选模结合。开发者选 Fusion 与努力档位后，系统按任务决定用单模型、级联（Cascade）还是批判修订（Critique）流程。

- Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上，Fusion Max 得分 60，与 Claude Code + Opus 5.5 Max 相差约 2 分，但平均 API 成本约一半、耗时约少 40%。
- Octoverse：过去12个月向 GitHub 推送 179 亿次；带智能体配置文件的新仓库平均提交量约为无配置仓库的 8 倍。
- 付费用户短期使用 Fusion 可享模型费用 30% 折扣；企业可管控 Fusion 可用模型并设为默认。

来源：[GitHub Changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-route-and-orchestrate-models-with-github-copilot-fusion/)、[Octoverse 2026](https://github.blog/news-insights/octoverse/octoverse-commits-pushes-reach-new-highs-in-2026-as-developers-build-with-agents/)
body.en:
Copilot Fusion combines Project HydraFusion multi-model orchestration with auto model selection. After picking Fusion and an effort level, it chooses single-model, cascade, or critique workflows per task.

- On the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, Fusion Max scored 60—within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max—at about half the average API cost and about 40% less time per task.
- Octoverse: developers pushed to GitHub 17.9 billion times in 12 months; new repos with an agent config averaged eight times as many commits as those without.
- Paid users get a limited-time 30% discount on model costs when using Fusion; admins can restrict which models Fusion may use and set it as the default.

Sources: [GitHub Changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-route-and-orchestrate-models-with-github-copilot-fusion/), [Octoverse 2026](https://github.blog/news-insights/octoverse/octoverse-commits-pushes-reach-new-highs-in-2026-as-developers-build-with-agents/)

title.zh: 媒体称 OpenAI 计划采购谷歌 TPU，以分散对英伟达依赖
title.en: OpenAI plans to buy Google TPUs to diversify beyond Nvidia, report says

summary.zh: The Information 报道 OpenAI 计划购买谷歌张量处理单元（TPU），在已于2025年租用基础上扩大算力并降低对英伟达 GPU 的依赖；交易细节未披露，双方均未正式确认。Oracle 亦称将在云端提供谷歌 TPU。
summary.en: The Information reported OpenAI plans to buy Google Tensor Processing Units after renting them since 2025, diversifying beyond Nvidia GPUs. Terms were undisclosed and neither company confirmed. Oracle also said Google TPUs will come to its cloud.

body.en:
According to The Information, OpenAI wants Google's custom AI accelerators to add training and inference capacity while reducing sole reliance on Nvidia. OpenAI had already rented Google chips; a purchase would deepen that tie even as the two compete in chatbots and search.

- Final pricing and volumes were not reported. Neither OpenAI nor Google publicly confirmed the deal.
- Separately, Oracle said Google TPUs would arrive on Oracle Cloud in 2027, the first major deployment outside Google's own cloud, alongside Cerebras systems.

Sources: [Investing.com / Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/openai-plans-to-buy-googles-ai-chips-the-information-reports-4977342), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/openai-plans-buy-googles-ai-chips-information-reports-6498406)

title.zh: 西班牙高铁相撞至少68死，桑切斯宣布全国哀悼三天
title.en: Spain train crash kills at least 68; Sánchez declares three days of mourning

summary.zh: 10月28日马德里至安达卢西亚高铁线托莱多附近，一列Renfe列车追尾停驶的Iryo列车，造成至少68人死亡、逾百人受伤；首相桑切斯宣布全国哀悼三天。交通部长称调度中心发出“难以解释”的复开指令。
summary.en: On Oct. 28 a Renfe high-speed train rear-ended a halted Iryo train near Urda, Toledo, killing at least 68 and injuring over 100. PM Sánchez declared three days of mourning. Officials blamed an “inexplicable” control-centre order after a signalling failure.

body.zh:
事故发生在乌尔达附近，两列同向列车共载约544人；这是西班牙今年第二起重大高铁事故（1月亚当斯附近已造成46人死亡）。

- 交通部长普恩特称，LZB 信号系统约上午8:30因电脑故障失效，约63公里区间多列列车停下；调度中心随后指示至少两列恢复正常运行，尽管仍有停车信号。
- Renfe 列车在约17分钟内行驶约25公里后撞上停住的 Iryo 列车；普恩特称另一名司机曾纠正类似错误指令。
- 桑切斯誓言彻查，若有过失将严肃追责；反对党要求全面独立审查铁路安全。

来源：[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/28/spain-train-crash-high-speed-toledo)、[新华社](https://english.news.cn/20261029/707472c613e34d06b755dec9e30d720d/c.html)
body.en:
The crash near Urda involved about 544 passengers on the Madrid–Andalusia high-speed line—Spain’s second major HSR disaster this year after January’s Adamuz crash that killed 46.

- Transport minister Óscar Puente said the LZB system failed around 8:30am, stranding trains across roughly 63km; the Madrid control centre then ordered at least two trains to resume normal running despite a stop signal.
- The Renfe train travelled about 25km in roughly 17 minutes before hitting the stationary Iryo train. Puente said another driver had refused a similar order.
- Sánchez pledged a thorough probe; the opposition called for a full independent review of rail safety.

Sources: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/28/spain-train-crash-high-speed-toledo), [Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20261029/707472c613e34d06b755dec9e30d720d/c.html)

title.zh: 以色列大选初步结果：反内塔尼亚胡阵营约67席，组阁前景胶着
title.en: Israel election: anti-Netanyahu camp near 67 seats, no clear majority path

summary.zh: 以色列议会选举计票逾八成后，反对内塔尼亚胡的政党合计约67席（含阿拉伯政党约19席），内氏阵营约53席；两方均难单独过61席门槛，最终结果仍待军队等双信封选票计完。
summary.en: With most regular ballots counted, parties opposed to Benjamin Netanyahu held about 67 of 120 Knesset seats (including roughly 19 for Arab parties) versus about 53 for his bloc. Neither side can easily clear 61 alone; absentee ballots remain.

body.en:
Updated results after roughly 85–89% of regular polling-station votes showed Gadi Eisenkot’s Jewish-led opposition bloc around the high 40s and Arab lists near 19, for a combined anti-Netanyahu total near 67. Netanyahu’s camp sat near 53.

- About half a million double-envelope votes from military bases, hospitals and other sites were still being counted, with completion expected by Friday and fuller tallies into early November.
- Many opposition parties have ruled out relying on Arab parties for a governing majority, leaving coalition maths uncertain.

Sources: [Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20261029/707472c613e34d06b755dec9e30d720d/c.html), [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-10-28/ty-article/.premium/with-85-6-of-votes-counted-opposition-wins-67-seats-with-19-for-arab-parties/000001a1-82fc-d9a9-a3ed-9bfcdc4c0000)

title.zh: Alphabet 盘前跌约10%，或创上市以来财报后最大跌幅；微软涨近4%
title.en: Alphabet slides ~10% premarket toward its worst post-earnings drop; Microsoft up ~4%

summary.zh: 10月29日美股盘前，Alphabet 因三季报自由现金流大幅为负、搜索广告增长不及预期而跌约10%，若收盘跌超9.77%将创2004年上市以来财报后最大跌幅；微软因资本开支低于预期、现金流仍为正上涨近4%，纳指期货跌约1%。
summary.en: On Oct. 29 Alphabet fell about 10% premarket after deeper-than-expected negative free cash flow and soft search ads—set for its worst post-earnings drop since 2004 if it closes below −9.77%. Microsoft rose nearly 4% on lighter-than-feared capex. Nasdaq futures fell about 1%.

body.zh:
市场焦点从营收增速转向 AI 投入回报。Alphabet 三季度自由现金流约 −90.7 亿美元（分析师原预期约 −27 亿），全年资本开支指引仍为 1950–2050 亿美元；搜索广告增 12% 至约 633.5 亿美元，略逊预期。

- 微软当季资本开支与融资租赁约 452 亿美元（同比 +30%），低于分析师约 506.7 亿美元预期；自由现金流降至约 186.3 亿美元但仍为正。
- 分析师称微软扩张更“克制”，Alphabet 财报与电话会则显混乱；投资者开始更严格审视超大规模云厂商的烧钱节奏。

来源：[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/alphabet-google-microsoft-msft-shares-today-earnings.html)、[Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nasdaq-futures-slide-as-mixed-big-tech-results-test-ai-trade-4981842)
body.en:
Investors shifted from growth headlines to AI returns. Alphabet’s free cash flow was about −$9.07B versus roughly −$2.7B expected; full-year capex guidance stayed $195B–$205B. Search ads grew 12% to about $63.35B, missing estimates.

- Microsoft’s capex and finance leases were $45.2B (+30% YoY), below ~$50.67B expected; free cash flow fell to about $18.63B but stayed positive.
- Quilter Cheviot’s Ben Barringer said Microsoft’s build-out looks measured while Alphabet’s results and call looked messy. Nasdaq-100 futures were down more than 1%.

Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/alphabet-google-microsoft-msft-shares-today-earnings.html), [Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nasdaq-futures-slide-as-mixed-big-tech-results-test-ai-trade-4981842)

title.zh: 欧洲央行行长拉加德宣布2027年2月7日提前卸任
title.en: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down on 7 February 2027

summary.zh: 欧洲央行10月29日称，行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德已告知理事会与欧洲理事会主席科斯塔，将于2027年2月7日卸任，较八年任期提前约九个月；继任者将按条约程序由欧洲理事会任命。
summary.en: The ECB said on Oct. 29 that President Christine Lagarde will leave on 7 February 2027, about nine months before her eight-year term ends. The European Council will appoint her successor under the Treaty process.

body.en:
Lagarde has led the ECB since late 2019 through the pandemic, energy shocks and euro-area inflation above 11%. Her term was due to run to October 2027.

- European Council President António Costa thanked her and said the succession process would start at once for a timely euro-area composition decision under Article 283 TFEU.
- The Governing Council gave her a standing ovation. Markets awaited the ECB’s latest policy decision later Thursday.

Sources: [ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr261029~abbb6dc64b.en.html), [European Council](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/10/29/statement-by-president-antonio-costa-on-the-forthcoming-departure-of-christine-lagarde-from-the-european-central-bank/)

title.zh: 商务部等四部门出台16项措施，提高海南自贸港贸易自由化便利化水平
title.en: Four ministries issue 16 measures to ease trade in Hainan Free Trade Port

summary.zh: 商务部、国家发改委、生态环境部、海关总署联合印发通知，从货物贸易、服务贸易、新业态三方面提出16项措施，优化保税监管与研发测试，提升外籍人员入境执业便利，并深化与香港及粤港澳大湾区合作。
summary.en: Commerce, NDRC, ecology and customs ministries jointly issued 16 measures for Hainan’s Free Trade Port—upgrading goods trade, opening services (including foreign professionals), and expanding bonded repair, remanufacturing and ties with Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.

sources.name: 中华人民共和国商务部

body.zh:
《通知》聚焦汽车、石化新材料等产业，提出优化保税监管、保税交割、研发测试等支持举措；服务贸易方面扩大医疗、保险、职业资格认可等开放，提升外籍人员入境与执业便利；新业态方面探索保税维修、再制造，支持海南与香港全面深化合作。

- 部门要求海南落实主体责任并强化风险防控。

来源：[商务部](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/xwfb/rcxwfb/art/2026/art_3474b02cab214c10b4a4fe49892b89da.html)
body.en:
The notice backs bonded supervision, delivery and R&D testing for autos and petrochemical materials; widens openings in healthcare, insurance and foreign professional credentials; and explores bonded repair and remanufacturing while deepening Hainan–Hong Kong and Greater Bay Area cooperation.

- Agencies told Hainan to take primary implementation responsibility and strengthen risk controls.

Source: [Ministry of Commerce](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/xwfb/rcxwfb/art/2026/art_3474b02cab214c10b4a4fe49892b89da.html)

title.zh: 首批风云卫星极端天气AI模型发布，台风解译约27秒出报告
title.en: China releases first Fengyun satellite AI models for extreme weather

summary.zh: 10月29日风云卫星用户大会上，国家卫星气象中心发布台风智能云图解译与强对流短临预警两套AI模型：前者约每15分钟运行、27秒生成解译文本；后者用风云四号近两小时观测预判未来四小时云图演变。
summary.en: On Oct. 29 China released Fengyun AI models for typhoon cloud interpretation and severe-convection nowcasting. The typhoon model runs about every 15 minutes and drafts text in 27 seconds; the convection model forecasts four-hour cloud evolution from two hours of FY-4 data.

body.zh:
台风模型融合多通道云图与20余种实况产品，覆盖7类台风特征，可自动分析位置、结构、强度与演变并可视化依据；强对流模型将云图演变拆解为“大系统移动”与“小系统生消”，把预警提前至约四小时。

- 发布现场还介绍了许健民气象卫星创新中心相关AI攻关团队。

来源：[中国气象局](https://www.cma.gov.cn/2011xwzx/2011xqxxw/2011xqxyw/202610/t20261029_8115448.html)
body.en:
The typhoon model fuses multi-channel imagery and 20-plus products across seven feature types, with visual explanations. The convection model separates large-scale motion from local cell growth/decay to push warnings toward a four-hour lead time.

- Organizers also introduced an AI satellite-meteorology innovation team under the Xu Jianmin center.

Source: [China Meteorological Administration](https://www.cma.gov.cn/2011xwzx/2011xqxxw/2011xqxyw/202610/t20261029_8115448.html)
